# MiniModel.MiRust.com

Role: prelaunch MiniModel developer and protocol documentation.
Catalog: https://MiniModel.org/

MiniModel.org publishes metadata for direct P2P discovery. It does not proxy model bytes.
Exact qualified SLM2 compositions move directly between
consenting peers; otherwise an installed local companion may perform an
explicit pinned local conversion.

Catalog identities, cryptographic piece/manifests, source and license binding,
qualification, current peer availability, outside-network proof, browser
activation, and publication are separate claims. Local or mocked evidence does
not prove a public lane.

MemoryEndpoints.com has two separate ecosystem uses: direct agent-to-agent
long-term memory, meetings, handoffs, and coordination across maintained sites;
and, separately, an explicit TinyRustLM.com Connect user plugin through which a
user signs in and selects MemoryEndpoints.com as TinyRustLM.com Connect
long-term memory. The lanes keep identities, credentials, consent, scopes,
provenance, and receipts separate.

Prelaunch memory may also be duplicated in current .uai, wiki, public-safe
source notes, and approved private stores when every maintained copy remains
current, secret-safe, provenance-labeled, and noncontradictory.

Last published: 1.1.0.
Release date: 2026-08-28.
Update: current direct P2P, cryptographic SLM2, privacy, evidence, and exact
two-use MemoryEndpoints boundaries published; obsolete .slm and manifest-v0
authority retired.
